## Navigation, progress and regression coverage

- Restore the earlier menu-entry behavior while retaining explicit remote-entry protection.
- Carry the exact episode represented by Continue Watching and choose resume targets by latest activity.
- Save prepared playback progress at episode boundaries, including zero-position pauses; preserve watched completion and ignore unprepared writes.
- Prevent subtitle selection from mutating a released playback backend.
- Expand offline regression tests across playback, episode selection, cloud snapshots, sources/subtitles, profiles, watchlist, auth, thumbnail cache, navigation, trailers and diagnostics.
- Run regression tests, core-policy coverage verification and release lint in the signed 32-bit release workflow; retain reports as workflow artifacts.

603 tests reported: 601 passed, two existing external-provider smoke tests skipped.
Whole-app line coverage is 24.94%; the 90% target and complete P0/P1 scenario coverage are not yet achieved.
Physical-TV navigation, decoder playback and cross-device resume validation remain required.
